messages.text: What was the net revenue of each of my brands this year?

args.purpose: Net revenue by brand for the current year (2026)
args.sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2026
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
